note: Authoritative 12-item rubric matching SPEC.md and TEST-PLAN.md (12/10/10/8/6/14/10/8/8/6/4/4 = 100). Score each honestly - a generous score helps nobody.

items.name: Headline
items.full_marks: States who you help and what changes for them, carries one piece of proof, and is not just the job title. Uses the 220 characters, not 60.

items.name: About: First 2 Lines
items.full_marks: First two lines - everything visible before 'see more' - name the reader's problem. No 'passionate about', no third-person bio, no opening with your own name.

items.name: About: Body & Proof
items.full_marks: Written to one person in second person: their problem, what you do, one number as proof, what to do next. Under 1,400 characters.

items.name: Featured Items
items.full_marks: Three items: best-performing post, a proof asset, and the way to contact you. Nothing empty, nothing stale.

items.name: Banner & Visual Positioning
items.full_marks: One line of positioning and one way to reach you. Not the default gradient, not a stock skyline.

items.name: Experience Outcomes & Metrics
items.full_marks: Last two roles detailed with clear scope and 2-3 outcome bullets with concrete numbers/metrics. Duties are not outcomes.

items.name: Recommendations
items.full_marks: At least three received in the last two years, each naming a specific outcome rather than generic character praise.

items.name: Skills & Badges
items.full_marks: Top three skills are the core three you want to be hired/known for and are endorsed. Clean, prioritized skill list.

items.name: Creator Mode Cadence
items.full_marks: Active posting or engagement within the last seven days. Regular publishing cadence.

items.name: Education & Credentials
items.full_marks: Relevant degrees, professional certifications, or recent continuous education with valid credentials.

items.name: Custom URL & Contact Clarity
items.full_marks: Clean custom LinkedIn URL, working email or booking link in contact info, consistent handle.

items.name: Headshot & Aesthetic Consistency
items.full_marks: Face fills roughly 60% of the frame, eyes visible, shot in the last two years, clear non-distracting background.
